{{Short description|Indian battery manufacturer}} {{About|the Indian battery company|the organization devoted to the preservation of japanese dogs|Nihon Ken Hozonkai}} {{Use dmy dates|date=August 2018}} {{Use Indian English|date=August 2018}} {{More citations needed|date=July 2025}}{{Infobox company | name = Indo National Limited | logo = Nippo-Logo-2023.png | type = [[Public company|Public]] | traded_as = {{ubl|{{NSE|NIPPOBATRY}}|{{BSE|504058}}}} | company_slogan = | founded = 1972 | founder = [[P Obul Reddy]] | hq_location = [[Chennai]], [[Tamil Nadu]], India | key_people = | area_served = | industry = [[Electronics]] | products = [[Battery (electricity)|Batteries]]
Torches | revenue = {{INR}}2832.5m | operating_income = {{INR}}35.9m | net_income = {{INR}}60.2m | num_employees = 540 | parent = | subsidiaries = | website = {{official URL}} | footnotes = }} '''Indo National Limited''' is a company that manufactures batteries in [[India]]. The corporate office is in [[Chennai]], [[Tamil Nadu]].The company spans 33 offices through the country. Nippo batteries reach millions of homes through 35 distributors, over 2800 stockists, 900 vans and 500 autos covering over 5 lakh (500,000) retail outlets. Nippo is the second largest [[dry cell battery]] manufacturer in India, with 28% of the market in 2006. The company started exporting batteries in 1976, with the first consignment exported to Yemen.{{Cite web |title=http://www.nippobatteries.com/html/prof_history.asp |url=http://www.nippobatteries.com/html/prof_history.asp |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127152232/http://www.nippobatteries.com/html/prof_history.asp |archive-date=27 November 2024 |access-date=2025-10-15 |website=www.nippobatteries.com |language=en |url-status=live }} ==Production== Nippo has two main production facilities for its batteries, [[Nellore]] and [[Tada, Nellore district|Tada]] both in [[Andhra Pradesh]]. ==Achievements== Nippo has received many awards. One product, Nippo Gold, was rated the 'Best Performing AA cell' in the country.{{Citation needed|date=January 2010}} The recent award they got is "Best Management Award 2010"{{Cite web |title=http://www.nippobatteries.com/html/news_awards.asp |url=http://www.nippobatteries.com/html/news_awards.asp |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250221075637/http://www.nippobatteries.com/html/news_awards.asp |archive-date=21 February 2025 |access-date=2025-10-15 |website=www.nippobatteries.com |language=en |url-status=live }}{{better source needed|date=September 2023}} ==Products== [[File:Nippo AA4-Battery (Rechargeable) Pack with recharger.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An [[AA battery|AA]]4-Battery (Rechargeable) Pack with recharger]] Nippo manufactures many batteries of various types. Their products include: * UM-1S - Nippo Hyper, Nippo Super, Nippo Special, Nippo Super Smart, Nippo Hyper. * AA- Nippo Gold, Nippo Hyper, Nippo Super. Apart from batteries Nippo also manufactures appliances mainly torches. Some other products manufactured by Nippo are [[Battery_charger#Power_bank|Power Station]], Compact Fluorescent Lamp and Emergency Power. ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://archive.today/20130118135124/http://investing.businessweek.com/research/stocks/snapshot/snapshot.asp?capId=10015656 Business Week company information] *[http://www.nippobatteries.com Nippo's Official Site] [[Category:Consumer battery manufacturers]] [[Category:Chemical companies of India]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Chennai]] [[Category:Chemical companies established in 1972]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1972]] [[Category:1972 establishments in Tamil Nadu]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
